fusions.name: Lance the Abscess
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health, a threshold that rises with each rank. A lancing stab deals 18 damage and draws out every affliction on the target, adding 1.3 times their remaining damage.

fusions.name: Bitter Quills
fusions.desc: Sprays quills tipped with drawn venom across a cone 4 tiles ahead. The spray deals 12 damage to everything in it and leaves each target [Poisoned] for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on each target spread to enemies within 3.5 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Bled Clean
fusions.desc: You lance your own wounds: removes up to 3 poisons from you and restores 10 health.

fusions.name: Needle Finds a Vein
fusions.desc: Your afflictions take hold on an enemy that is immune to them. You have 10% poison resistance.
